column2: pathfinding and movement of the AI units (the person: soldiers stop in the open, vehicles spin, get wedged in other vehicles, terrain and obstacles): causes found - a squad's ring of arrival points repeated every 3 men (angle 2.1 x 3 = a full turn), so the 4th man shared the 1st's spot, they shoved each other for ever and the squad never arrived; vehicles checked only their centre and steered at a point 4.5 m ahead, cutting corners into walls and retrying; no vehicle-to-vehicle collision; vehicles of several squads sent to one point got the very same point; a goal off the map gave no path. Fixes: claimSpot/takenSpots (each unit its own free spot; vehicles on a spot the hull fits, reachable straight from the point, minding only hulls), soldiers stop when 1.2 s within 2.5 m of a crowded end; vehFits (four corners), vehLine (lookahead only as far as the hull drives straight), hullFree (no hull into another), slide along an obstacle, back up 0.9 s and re-plan when wedged, give way only to moving vehicles (lower id first), stop when held up within 5 m of the end, always pass a path point already reached (it spun steering at a point 8 cm away), overlapping hulls pushed apart, the path round standing hulls as wide as the hull; findPath clamps an off-map goal to the edge; infantry A* node limit 6000 to 12000; veh_gap added
column3: 36 runs on the test map (4 cases x 9: far across the map, all to one point, into the village, back toward the map edge; every squad at once, ROE hold, no targets), arrived = stopped within 10 m of the point: before - soldiers 44/180, vehicles 100/108, hulls overlapping 280-440 s per case, in the village 220 s of vehicles blocked; after - soldiers 180/180, vehicles 108/108, overlap 0 s, longest spin on the spot 3.7 s (a tracked hull turning round), last arrival 48 s on the 100 m trip
